plot: The morning after Hal came home, Turbo zooms up to the old drive-in's blinking light and bumps the projector, then finds a crack in the lens just as Hal announces Saturday's movie night; Turbo blames 'the wind', the shop has no lens for fifty years, and Grumpy decides to tow away the tree that 'caused' it, the hedgehog's home, so at sunset Turbo shouts the truth; Hal laughs: the crack is twenty years old, made by his own first honk as little Hally, and Turbo's bump only knocked off the old yellow tape seen on the floor; lesson: the truth is lighter than a secret; at movie night the old film shows a young Bolt in a brown hat.

script.title: Will Turbo Tell the Truth?

set.place: the old drive-in cinema field at the edge of Wheelburg, the morning after Hal came home, until sunset

script.description: Turbo cracks the old cinema lens — or did he? Inspector Bolt #20

beats.say: That light is still blinking! I'll get there first!
Uh-oh. The big round glass. It has a crack!
Nobody saw me. Should I tell? Or... not?
It was the morning after Hal came home to Wheelburg.
Here, at the old drive-in cinema, a light had blinked all night.
Hmph. Found it. An old bulb on a loose wire.
Old wires. Old bulbs. Old everything.
On the floor lay a strip of very old, yellow tape.
Nobody looked at it. Not yet.
Big news, everyone! Ho-ho-honk!
Movie night! Right here! This Saturday! The whole town!
A movie under the stars! I'll bring my biggest blanket!
Which movie, Hal? Which one? Tell me!
My favourite. The Little Purple Van. On the old projector.
That round lens is its heart. Careful with it.
Believe me. I know how easily it breaks.
The heart? Did you say... the heart?
Turbo's tyres felt heavy. Heavier than ever before.
Procedure. Before Saturday, we check every part.
Wires, fine. Screen, fine. Lens...
Hmm. A crack. Right across the middle.
Oh no! Who did this?
Everybody looked around. Turbo looked at the sky.
Um... the wind! A big wind! Last night!
Wind? I was out all night. There was no wind.
Well, a little wind. My blanket flapped once!
Then the wind is a crack-maker! Naughty wind!
Bolt said nothing. But he saw a tiny sparkle on Turbo's bumper.
Interesting. Very interesting.
Without the lens, there's no movie. No movie night.
No movie night? But I already told my whole street!
We have until sunset to fix it. Or Saturday is off.
I'll get a new lens! Fast! I'm the fastest!
Turbo raced to the shop on Bakery Lane.
A round glass for an old projector? Not for fifty years, said the shop.
Fifty years? Oh no. Oh no, no, no.
Back at the cinema, Grumpy had a plan.
If the wind did it, it used that old tree.
Its branch bangs the window. At sunset, I tow the tree away.
Good thinking, Grumpy! No tree, no wind trouble!
Wait! The hedgehog lives under that tree!
The one from the night we found Hal!
Hmph. Hedgehogs can move. Trees can't.
Turbo heard everything. His little lie was growing.
First the lens. Now the tree. And the hedgehog.
Bolt rolled over. Slowly. Quietly.
Turbo. Do you know what a secret is like?
A stone in your tyre. It gets heavier every mile.
Heavier every minute. I know.
The sun was low now. Grumpy hooked his chain to the tree.
He's pulling it! The hedgehog's home is going!
STOP! Grumpy, stop! It wasn't the wind!
It was me! I zoomed up to see the light.
I bumped the lens. Crash. And then I lied.
Everybody went very quiet. Even the birds.
I'm sorry, Hal. I broke your movie night.
Hal looked at the lens. Then he began to shake.
Ho... ho-ho-HONK!
Turbo, that crack is older than you are!
I made it. Twenty years ago. When I was little Hally.
My very first big honk. Too close to the glass!
Then what went crash this morning?
The yellow tape. It covered the old crack for years.
Turbo's bump only knocked the tape off.
So I didn't break it? I was scared all day for nothing?
Not for nothing. You told the truth when it was hard.
And the truth saved a tree. And a hedgehog.
Hmph. Tree stays. Good. I like that tree.
Remember, everyone. The truth is lighter than a secret.
The truth is lighter than a secret! I feel lighter too!
Grumpy brought new tape. Turbo and Hal stuck it on together.
That Saturday, the big screen lit up at last.
Look! A little line across the picture. Like a smile!
That's the Hally line. It's always been there!
Everybody laughed. Even Grumpy. Even the hedgehog, probably.
Then the old film showed a little blue car in a brown hat.
Bolt? Is that YOU in the movie?!
Oh dear. I hoped nobody would ever see that.

beats.text: WHY IS BOLT IN THE MOVIE?

beats.say: What do you think Bolt will find next time? We'll find out in the next episode!

long.title: Will Turbo Tell the Truth? 😬🎬 (Ep 20)
long.description:
"Nobody saw me. So why does my secret feel so heavy?" — Turbo
Zooming up to the old drive-in's blinking light, Turbo bumps the projector — and the lens has a crack. Movie night is Saturday, Grumpy wants to tow away the hedgehog's tree, and Turbo's little lie keeps growing. Inspector Bolt #20
